clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon prepares the Elixir of Pain for a field trial. Stanley, Farmer Ray’s dog in Hillsbrad Fields, is the chosen subject.

Apothecary Lydon works in Tarren Mill for the Royal Apothecary Society and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. He gathers fresh blood from local wildlife and uses it to brew a volatile mixture called the Elixir of Pain. The Society seeks field evidence of how its experimental poisons and mutagens affect living bodies.

Lydon sends his agents to the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields, away from the human defenders. Farmer Ray keeps a pet dog there named Stanley. With the draught poured into an open hand, an agent offers it to the unsuspecting dog as an ordinary treat.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, nothing like the smell of fresh blood in the foothills!

Now we'll mix in a touch of this and a little of that and let the real fun begin! What I have created with this blood, I like to call an Elixir of Pain. If my calculations are correct this concoction could be the start of something very beautiful for Lady Sylvanas. But what we need is a test.
Take this elixir out to the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields to the southwest. Let's see how Farmer Ray's little dog Stanley likes this "treat."

clips.title: Completion
paras: You pour some of the elixir into your hand and hold it before Stanley's mouth.
